summary: Describes an abstract mechanism for delivering root keys from an EAP server to another network server that needs them to offer services such as re-authentication to an EAP peer. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: After you prove who you are once, a key can be passed to other helpers so you do not have to prove it again at each one. This document describes how to hand that key over safely.

questions: how are eap keys distributed for handover
